items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: I played with Mel Torme. And Doc Severinsen on the bottom there before he was famous.

ctx.x: Clyde Lombardi. I don’t know that name.
Yeah. He was around that time. Now this is the Gene Krupa Quartet and then Doc Severinsen before he was famous.
